SYNNOVIS ANALYTICS
CELLULAR PATHOLOGY
Histopathology

Patient: Jane Smith    DOB: 14/03/1962    Accession: S26-04417
Reported by: Dr A. Patel (GMC 1234567), Guy's Hospital, 12/09/2026

Clinical details: Screen-detected left breast mass, discussed at the Guy's Hospital breast MDT on 12/09/2026 by Dr A. Patel. For wide local excision and sentinel node biopsy. Right breast B3 lesion on core biopsy.

A. Left breast, wide local excision:
- Invasive carcinoma of no special type, 18mm, Nottingham grade 2 (3+2+2=7)
- Associated high-grade ductal carcinoma in situ with comedo necrosis
- Lymphovascular invasion is not identified
- Perineural invasion is suspected but not definite
- Nearest margin is the deep margin, clear at 3mm
- ER positive (Allred 8/8), PR positive (Allred 6/8), HER2 negative (IHC score 1+)

B. Left axilla, sentinel lymph nodes x3:
- Three lymph nodes examined, no tumour seen (0/3)

C. Right breast, vacuum-assisted biopsy (previous core S26-04102):
- Atypical ductal hyperplasia (B3). Malignancy cannot be excluded; excision advised.
- ER could not be assessed; insufficient lesional tissue in the block
